faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers about our services, installation process, and support.

items.question: How quickly can CamTek install my security cameras?
items.answer: Most residential and commercial installations are completed within 5–7 business days after the site survey. We also offer fast-track scheduling for urgent projects.

items.question: Do you provide warranties on equipment and installation?
items.answer: Yes. All systems come with a comprehensive warranty on both equipment and installation work, plus optional maintenance packages for ongoing support.

items.question: Can I access my security system from my smartphone?
items.answer: Absolutely. We configure mobile access so you can view live feeds, receive alerts, and play back recordings from anywhere.

items.question: What types of properties do you serve?
items.answer: We work with homes, offices, retail stores, warehouses, factories, and mixed-use properties across Kuwait.

items.question: Is remote monitoring available with your CCTV solutions?
items.answer: Yes. Remote monitoring and alerting options are available so your system can notify you and our support team when important events occur.

story.title: Our Story
story.description: CamTek has been at the forefront of security solutions in Kuwait for over a decade. We started with a simple mission: to provide reliable, high-quality surveillance systems that protect what matters most to our clients. Today, we serve hundreds of homes, businesses, and industrial facilities across Kuwait.
